reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added Platform-specific configurations for Helm installs", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Environments using OpenShift profile variants (e.g., profile=ambient-openshift) must migrate to --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=openshift; the old profile variants are no longer supported.

proposed.statement: OpenShift profile variants for Helm installs are removed and replaced with global.platform=openshift configuration; a new global.platform Helm value enables platform-specific configurations.
